strategy: Focused, source-backed metro pilot. Do not mass-publish neighborhood variations, assert measured local ROI, or create fictional advertisers.

minimum_publish_evidence: A distinct, useful local user question and at least one current primary source for material local claims
Verified real-world provider/service or official resource; address, service scope and offer limitations checked
No duplicative local doorway page or recycled place-name substitutions
Explicit independent editorial disclosure; no implied referral contracts or availability
Existing indexed pages checked for cannibalization before a new route is created
minimum_scale_evidence: Locale-specific search impression, volume and SERP competition analysis
Actual indexed/clicked pages and usable lead conversions by market
Verified paying advertiser or other realized revenue and attributable operating costs
decision_policy.without_scale_evidence: Do not describe the cluster as blue ocean, highest ROI or a proven revenue opportunity. Continue only bounded editorial tests.
